scope.rationale: D247-02 is the production cache unit: a new internal JsonRowWriterCache + semantic key, the internal ResolveMemberName sharing, the context-owned cache wiring in DataContext and the process-wide invalidation generation in DataContextCache, plus one focused unit test file. Compiled inputs change, so rebuild is "affected"; the inner loop is the affected nextorm.core.tests JSON subset (one project build, then --no-build filtered runs) and the full boundary sweep belongs to the DO->CHECK flow boundary, not this unit.
